svg.aria-label: Parallel Edge Detection, AVX interior and clamped border. Blur mode 4 and gradient mode 3 run two OpenMP loops over rows. Pass 1 covers the interior, a margin of kernel radius r from every edge (2 for the 5x5 blur, 1 for the 3x3 gradient): 8-pixel AVX blocks, then a scalar remainder of fewer than 8 pixels per row, with no bounds checks. Pass 2 visits every pixel, skips the 2-pixel interior with continue and computes the border ring with clamped coordinates; for the gradient it also recomputes the 1-pixel ring pass 1 already wrote. Per tap, pass 1 loads 8 adjacent floats with _mm256_loadu_ps, broadcasts the kernel weight with _mm256_set1_ps, multiplies and adds into the sum with _mm256_mul_ps and _mm256_add_ps; after the 25 or 9 taps the gradient takes _mm256_sqrt_ps of xsum squared plus ysum squared, and _mm256_storeu_ps writes the 8 results.
svg.text: Parallel Edge Detection — AVX interior, clamped border
Blur mode 4 and gradient mode 3: an unclamped interior pass (AVX + scalar tail), then a clamped border pass.
WHICH PASS WRITES WHICH PIXEL — DRAWN FOR A 22 × 10 IMAGE
AVX margin 2 = kernel radius; pass-2 ring also 2 px
margin 2: pass 1 starts at x = 2, y = 2
Pass 1: rows 2–7 · AVX x 2–17 (two blocks) · scalar x 18–19
Pass 2: the orange 2-px ring; continue skips the interior
Dashed: the 5×5 stencil of (2, 2) reaches row 0 and column 0
At 2048 wide: 255 AVX blocks + 4 scalar pixels per row
AVX margin 1 = kernel radius; pass-2 ring still 2 px
AVX margin 1: pass 1 starts at x = 1, y = 1
pass-2 ring 2: same skip test as blur
Pass 1: rows 1–8 · AVX x 1–16 (two blocks) · scalar x 17–20
Pass 2 skips only the 2-px interior, so it recomputes the red
ring pass 1 already wrote (its clamps change nothing there)
Dashed: the 3×3 stencil of (1, 1) reaches row 0 and column 0
At 2048 wide: 255 AVX blocks + 6 scalar pixels per row
PASS ORDER · w × h IMAGE, r = KERNEL RADIUS (2 BLUR, 1 GRADIENT)
Pass 1 · interior rows r … h − r − 1
#pragma omp parallel for over y; no bounds checks
per row: 8-wide AVX blocks, then scalar remainder
Pass 2 · all h rows, border pixels only
#pragma omp parallel for over y, every pixel visited
continue if 2 ≤ x < w − 2 and 2 ≤ y < h − 2, else clamp
PASS 1 INNER LOOP — ONE BLOCK OF 8 OUTPUT PIXELS (x … x+7, y)
Lane k computes output pixel (x + k, y). For one tap (i, j) the 8 lanes need pixels x + i … x + i + 7 of row y + j:
8 adjacent floats in the row-major buffer, so a single unaligned load fills the register for the whole block.
The stencil never leaves the image, so no clamp: a block runs only while x + 8 ≤ w − r,
so its farthest read x + 7 + r ≤ w − 1, its nearest x − r ≥ 0, and rows y ± r stay in 0 … h − 1.
8 adjacent floats of row y + j,
one kernel weight in all 8 lanes
